Sample.evidence_source: The text describes a single study with a cognitive-behavioral group, a relaxation training group, and a wait-list group. The sample size is not explicitly stated as a total N, but the degrees of freedom in ANCOVA F(2, 20) and F(2, 17) suggest a total N around 23 (20+2+1 = 23, 17+2+1 = 20, so 23 is the maximum possible from the first F-stat).
Sample.warning: Total N for the study is inferred from degrees of freedom, not explicitly stated.

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/14] Comparisons indicated that the relaxation training group (Q_p = 3.95, p < .05) and cognitive-behavioral group (Q_p = 3.61, p < .05) means were significantly higher than the wait-list group mean.

dxgive.evidence_source: The text discusses self-concept measures and improved general self-esteem, but does not mention any diagnostic criteria for depression or any other disorder for inclusion or exclusion.
